Research position overview

The Cancer Research UK Manchester Institute recruits researchers for a four-year PhD programme. Applicants select research interests within the Institute's cancer science groups and compete for studentships that support tuition, living costs and the costs of the research project.

Research Areas

  • Cancer biology
  • Biomedical science
  • Cancer research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryGBP 21,113 year 1; 22,500 year 2; 22,894 year 3; 23,294 year 4
DurationFour years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsUK, EU and international applicants; tuition and bench costs supported.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round6 November 2026, 17:00 GMT
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Manchester

Manchester hosts doctoral programmes in medicine, bioscience and other research fields. Its Faculty of Biology, Medicine and Health coordinates funded training routes, including MRC programmes and cancer research studentships.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.cruk.manchester.ac.uk/submit-a-phd-studentship-application/

Source: cruk.manchester.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 6 November 2026, 17:00 GMT - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 6 November 2026, 17:00 GMT. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
